hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows || true
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); git rev-parse --git-dir *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { code-review-graph update --skip-flows *> $null }; exit 0"

hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$null = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); git rev-parse --git-dir *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { code-review-graph status } else { Write-Output 'Not a git repo, skipping' }; exit 0"
